args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions. Rollback verified (status: rolled_out).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).

3. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — verified `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for `checkout-api`, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.
